tools.name: get_current_weather
tools.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified location. This includes temperature, humidity, wind speed, and a brief description of the weather.

location.description: The city or ZIP code for which to get current weather.

unit.description: The unit of temperature (e.g., 'celsius', 'fahrenheit'). Defaults to 'celsius'.

tools.name: get_weather_forecast
tools.description: Provides a weather forecast for a specific location for a given number of days. It includes daily high/low temperatures and conditions.

location.description: The city or ZIP code for which to get the weather forecast.

days.description: The number of days for the forecast (1-7 days).

unit.description: The unit of temperature (e.g., 'celsius', 'fahrenheit'). Defaults to 'celsius'.

tools.name: set_weather_alert
tools.description: Sets up a custom weather alert for a specific location based on a condition (e.g., temperature threshold, severe weather).

location.description: The city or ZIP code for which to set the alert.

threshold_value.description: The value for the threshold (e.g., temperature in degrees). Required for temperature alerts.

unit.description: The unit for the threshold value (e.g., 'celsius', 'fahrenheit'). Required for temperature alerts.

active.description: Whether the alert should be immediately active. Defaults to true.

tools.name: get_historical_weather
tools.description: Fetches historical weather data for a specified location and date. This includes temperature, humidity, and conditions for that day.

location.description: The city or ZIP code for which to retrieve historical weather.

date.description: The specific date for historical weather data (YYYY-MM-DD). Date must be in the past.

unit.description: The unit of temperature (e.g., 'celsius', 'fahrenheit'). Defaults to 'celsius'.

tools.name: update_weather_alert
tools.description: Modifies an existing weather alert's parameters, such as its threshold, active status, or alert type.

alert_id.description: The unique identifier of the alert to update.

threshold_value.description: The new value for the threshold (e.g., temperature in degrees).

unit.description: The unit for the threshold value (e.g., 'celsius', 'fahrenheit').

active.description: Whether the alert should be active or inactive.

tools.name: get_latest_news_headlines
tools.description: Retrieves the most recent news headlines from various categories. Allows filtering by specific news categories or the number of headlines to return.

category.description: Optional. Filter headlines by a specific category (e.g., 'technology', 'sports', 'politics').

limit.description: Optional. The maximum number of headlines to retrieve, up to 100. Defaults to 10.

language.description: Optional. The language of the headlines (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish). Defaults to 'en'.

id.description: Unique identifier for the news article.

title.description: The headline of the news article.

source.description: The source publication of the article.

published_at.description: Timestamp when the article was published.

tools.name: search_news_articles
tools.description: Searches for news articles based on keywords, date range, and source. This tool is useful for finding specific articles or historical news.

query.description: Required. The keywords or phrase to search for in article titles and content.

from_date.description: Optional. Start date for the search range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

to_date.description: Optional. End date for the search range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

source.description: Optional. Filter results by a specific news source (e.g., 'BBC News', 'The New York Times').

page_size.description: Optional. The number of results per page, up to 50. Defaults to 20.

total_results.description: Total number of articles found matching the query.

id.description: Unique identifier for the news article.

title.description: The headline of the news article.

description.description: A brief summary of the article content.

source.description: The source publication of the article.

published_at.description: Timestamp when the article was published.

tools.name: get_article_details
tools.description: Retrieves the full content and metadata for a specific news article using its unique ID. This is useful for deep diving into a particular story.

article_id.description: Required. The unique identifier of the news article.

id.description: Unique identifier for the news article.

title.description: The headline of the news article.

source.description: The source publication of the article.

published_at.description: Timestamp when the article was published.

image_url.description: URL to the main image associated with the article.

content.description: The full textual content of the article.

category.description: The category of the news article.

tools.name: get_trending_topics
tools.description: Fetches a list of the current trending news topics or keywords globally or within a specific country. This helps identify what's popular right now.

country.description: Optional. The two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code to get trending topics for (e.g., 'us', 'gb', 'in'). Defaults to global trends if not specified.

limit.description: Optional. The maximum number of trending topics to return, up to 20. Defaults to 10.

topic.description: The trending news topic or keyword.

rank.description: The popularity rank of the topic.

news_count.description: The number of news articles associated with this topic.

tools.name: subscribe_to_newsletter
tools.description: Subscribes a user to a daily or weekly news digest newsletter for a specified category. Users will receive updates directly to their email.

email.description: Required. The user's email address for the subscription.

category.description: Required. The news category to subscribe to (e.g., 'business', 'technology', 'world').

frequency.description: Optional. The desired frequency of the newsletter ('daily', 'weekly'). Defaults to 'daily'.

send_welcome_email.description: Optional. Whether to send an immediate welcome email. Defaults to true.

success.description: True if the subscription was successful, false otherwise.

message.description: A confirmation or error message regarding the subscription.

subscription_id.description: Unique ID for the new subscription if successful.

tools.name: get_news_source_status
tools.description: Checks the operational status of a specific news source or all registered news sources. Useful for identifying issues or available sources.

source_name.description: Optional. The name of a specific news source to check (e.g., 'CNN', 'Reuters'). If not provided, returns status for all sources.
The name of the news source.

status.description: The current operational status ('operational', 'degraded', 'offline').

last_updated.description: Timestamp of the last status update.

articles_in_past_hour.description: Number of new articles published by this source in the last hour.

tools.name: get_stock_quote
tools.description: Retrieves the current real-time quote for a given stock ticker symbol, including price, volume, and last trade time.

ticker_symbol.description: The ticker symbol of the stock (e.g., AAPL, GOOGL).

tools.name: search_stocks_by_industry
tools.description: Searches for stocks belonging to a specified industry, optionally filtering by market capitalization range.

min_market_cap_usd.description: Minimum market capitalization in USD to filter results (e.g., 1000000000).

max_market_cap_usd.description: Maximum market capitalization in USD to filter results (e.g., 50000000000).

exchange.description: The stock exchange to filter by (e.g., 'NYSE', 'NASDAQ').

tools.name: get_historical_prices
tools.description: Retrieves historical daily closing prices for a given stock ticker symbol over a specified date range.

ticker_symbol.description: The ticker symbol of the stock (e.g., MSFT).

start_date.description: The start date for the historical data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: The end date for the historical data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tools.name: get_portfolio_holdings
tools.description: Retrieves the current stock holdings for a specific portfolio ID, including shares, average cost, and current value.

portfolio_id.description: The unique identifier for the portfolio.

tools.name: cancel_trade_order
tools.description: Cancels a pending trade order using its unique order ID.

order_id.description: The unique identifier of the trade order to cancel.

portfolio_id.description: The portfolio ID associated with the order.

dropped.reason: The 'is_market_order' parameter conflicts with 'limit_price'. If 'is_market_order' is true, 'limit_price' should not be provided or required, and vice versa. The current 'required' array also lists 'is_market_order' as required, which makes it impossible to place a limit order without providing a redundant 'is_market_order: false'. tools.name: get_live_scores
tools.description: Retrieves real-time scores for ongoing sports matches. Users can filter by sport, league, or team to get specific live updates.

sport.description: The sport to retrieve live scores for (e.g., 'football', 'basketball', 'soccer').

league.description: The specific league to filter live scores by (e.g., 'NBA', 'Premier League').

team_name.description: The name of a specific team to get live scores for.

include_details.description: Set to true to include detailed play-by-play or individual player stats.

tools.name: get_past_game_results
tools.description: Fetches historical results for completed sports games. Users can specify a date range, sport, league, or team to find past game outcomes.

sport.description: The sport for which to retrieve past game results (e.g., 'cricket', 'rugby').

league.description: The specific league to filter past results by.

team_name.description: The name of a specific team to find past game results for.

start_date.description: The start date for the search range (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.description: The end date for the search range (YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: get_upcoming_games
tools.description: Provides a schedule of upcoming sports games. Users can filter by sport, league, team, or date to see future match-ups.

sport.description: The sport for which to retrieve upcoming games (e.g., 'tennis', 'hockey').

league.description: The specific league to filter upcoming games by.

team_name.description: The name of a specific team to find their upcoming schedule.

date.description: A specific date (YYYY-MM-DD) to look for upcoming games.

days_in_future.description: Number of days from today to look into the future for games.

tools.name: subscribe_to_team_updates
tools.description: Subscribes a user to receive notifications for a specific sports team's game updates, scores, and news. Requires a user ID and team name.

user_id.description: The unique identifier for the user subscribing.

team_name.description: The name of the team the user wants to subscribe to.

tools.name: get_league_standings
tools.description: Retrieves the current standings for a specified sports league. This includes team rankings, wins, losses, and other relevant metrics.

league.description: The name of the league for which to retrieve standings (e.g., 'NFL', 'La Liga').

season_year.description: The year of the season for which to get standings (e.g., 2023).

tools.name: update_game_score
tools.description: Updates the score for an ongoing or recently completed game. This tool is intended for administrative or authorized scorekeepers.

game_id.description: The unique identifier of the game to update.

home_score_update.description: The new score for the home team.

away_score_update.description: The new score for the away team.

current_period.description: The current period or quarter of the game.

time_remaining.description: Time remaining in the current period (e.g., '5:30').

is_final.description: Set to true if the game has concluded and this is the final score.

tools.name: search_encyclopedia_articles
tools.description: Searches for articles within the encyclopedia based on keywords, categories, or publication date. This tool is useful for finding relevant information on a given topic.

keywords.description: One or more keywords to search for within article titles or content.

category.description: Optional category to filter the search results (e.g., 'History', 'Science', 'Biography').

min_publication_year.description: Optional minimum publication year to filter articles.

max_publication_year.description: Optional maximum publication year to filter articles.

limit.description: The maximum number of articles to return in the search results (default: 10).

tools.name: get_article_details
tools.description: Retrieves the full content and metadata for a specific encyclopedia article using its unique ID. This allows for in-depth viewing of an article.

article_id.description: The unique identifier of the encyclopedia article to retrieve.

include_references.description: Whether to include a list of references at the end of the article content (default: false).

tools.name: submit_new_article_draft
tools.description: Submits a new article draft for review by encyclopedia editors. This tool is used by contributors to add new information to the encyclopedia.

title.description: The proposed title for the new article.

category.description: The primary category for the new article (e.g., 'History', 'Science').

content.description: The full content of the article draft.

author_name.description: The name of the author submitting the draft.

is_major_contribution.description: Indicates if this is a substantial new article or a minor addition (default: true).

draft_id.description: The unique ID assigned to the submitted draft.

status.description: The current status of the draft (e.g., 'pending_review').

message.description: A confirmation message.

tools.name: update_article_content
tools.description: Updates the content of an existing encyclopedia article. This tool is for making corrections or additions to published articles.

article_id.description: The unique identifier of the article to be updated.

new_content.description: The complete new content for the article. This will replace the existing content.

editor_id.description: The ID of the editor performing the update.

minor_edit.description: Set to true if this is a minor correction and does not require a full review process (default: false).

tools.name: get_article_revision_history
tools.description: Retrieves the revision history for a given encyclopedia article, showing who made changes and when. This is useful for tracking article evolution and accountability.

article_id.description: The unique identifier of the encyclopedia article.

limit.description: The maximum number of revisions to retrieve (default: 5).

tools.name: delete_article
tools.description: Deletes an existing encyclopedia article from the system. This action requires administrative privileges and is irreversible.

article_id.description: The unique identifier of the article to be deleted.

admin_user_id.description: The ID of the administrator performing the deletion.

reason.description: A brief explanation for the deletion.

confirm_deletion.description: Must be true to confirm the deletion action.

tools.name: lookup_definition
tools.description: Retrieves the definition(s) of a given word. Can specify language and part of speech to narrow down results.

language.description: The language of the word (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish). Defaults to 'en'.

part_of_speech.description: Filter definitions by part of speech (e.g., 'noun', 'verb', 'adjective').

tools.name: get_word_of_the_day
tools.description: Retrieves the 'word of the day' for a specified date and language. This can be used to discover new vocabulary.

date.description: The date for which to retrieve the word of the day, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today's date if not provided.

language.description: The language for the word of the day (e.g., 'en' for English). Defaults to 'en'.

tools.name: search_synonyms_antonyms
tools.description: Finds synonyms and antonyms for a given word. Users can specify whether to search for synonyms, antonyms, or both.

word.description: The word for which to find synonyms/antonyms.

search_type.description: Specifies whether to search for 'synonyms', 'antonyms', or 'both'.

language.description: The language of the word (e.g., 'en'). Defaults to 'en'.

tools.name: get_random_word
tools.description: Retrieves a random word from the dictionary. Can be filtered by language, part of speech, minimum length, and maximum length.

language.description: The language of the random word (e.g., 'en'). Defaults to 'en'.

has_definition.description: If true, only return words with an available definition. Defaults to true.

tools.name: add_custom_word
tools.description: Adds a new custom word and its definition to a user's personal dictionary. This allows users to store custom vocabulary or specialized terms.

definition.description: The definition for the custom word.

user_id.description: The ID of the user adding the word.

part_of_speech.description: The part of speech for the custom word (e.g., 'noun').

language.description: The language of the custom word. Defaults to 'en'.

tools.name: check_spelling
tools.description: Checks the spelling of a given word and suggests corrections if it's misspelled. Can specify language for more accurate checks.

word.description: The word to check for spelling.

language.description: The language context for spelling check (e.g., 'en' for English). Defaults to 'en'.

tools.name: translate_text
tools.description: Translates a given text from a source language to a target language. This tool is suitable for short to medium length texts.

text_to_translate.description: The text content to be translated.

source_language_code.description: The ISO 639-1 code of the source language (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish).

target_language_code.description: The ISO 639-1 code of the target language (e.g., 'fr' for French, 'de' for German).

formal_tone.description: Set to true if a formal tone is preferred in the translation, false otherwise. Defaults to false.

translated_text.description: The translated text in the target language.

detected_source_language.description: The ISO 639-1 code of the automatically detected source language, if different from input.

tools.name: get_supported_languages
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all language codes and their human-readable names that are supported by the translation service.

language_name_filter.description: An optional filter to search for languages by their human-readable name (e.g., 'English'). Case-insensitive.

language_code_filter.description: An optional filter to search for languages by their ISO 639-1 code (e.g., 'es').

languages.description: A JSON string representing an array of supported languages, each with 'code' and 'name' properties.

tools.name: queue_document_translation
tools.description: Submits a document for asynchronous translation. This is suitable for larger files or batches of text that require longer processing times. The translation will be processed in the background.

document_id.description: A unique identifier for the document to be translated. This ID can be used later to check the status or retrieve the translated document.

source_language_code.description: The ISO 639-1 code of the source language of the document.

target_language_code.description: The ISO 639-1 code of the target language for the document.

callback_url.description: An optional URL to which a notification will be sent upon completion of the translation.

priority.description: The priority level for the translation job, where higher numbers indicate higher priority (e.g., 1-5). Defaults to 3.

job_id.description: A unique identifier for the queued translation job.

status.description: The initial status of the translation job (e.g., 'queued', 'processing').

tools.name: get_translation_job_status
tools.description: Checks the current status of a previously submitted document translation job using its job ID.

job_id.description: The unique identifier of the translation job.
The unique identifier of the translation job.

status.description: The current status of the job (e.g., 'queued', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed').

progress_percentage.description: The completion percentage of the translation job, if available.

completion_time.description: The timestamp when the job was completed, if applicable (ISO 8601 format).

tools.name: retrieve_translated_document
tools.description: Retrieves the translated content of a document that was previously submitted and completed. This will return the translated document's content or a link to it.

job_id.description: The unique identifier of the completed translation job.

output_format.description: The desired format for the output document (e.g., 'plain_text', 'html', 'pdf'). Defaults to 'plain_text'.

job_id.description: The unique identifier of the translation job.

translated_content.description: The translated content of the document, if requested as plain text or small enough to embed directly.

download_url.description: A URL from which the translated document can be downloaded, especially for larger files or specific formats.

status.description: The status of the retrieval (e.g., 'success', 'not_found', 'job_not_completed').

tools.name: update_translation_memory
tools.description: Updates or adds a new entry to the translation memory for a specific language pair. This helps improve consistency and accuracy for future translations.

source_segment.description: The original text segment in the source language.

target_segment.description: The corresponding translated text segment in the target language.

source_language_code.description: The ISO 639-1 code of the source language.

target_language_code.description: The ISO 639-1 code of the target language.

domain.description: An optional domain or context for this translation memory entry (e.g., 'legal', 'medical', 'technical').

overwrite_existing.description: If true, overwrites an existing entry if source_segment, target_segment, and language codes match. Defaults to false.

status.description: The status of the update operation (e.g., 'success', 'added', 'updated', 'error').

entry_id.description: A unique identifier for the translation memory entry.

tools.name: convert_length
tools.description: Converts a length value from one unit to another (e.g., meters to feet, inches to centimeters).

from_unit.description: The unit of the input value (e.g., 'meter', 'foot', 'inch', 'centimeter').

to_unit.description: The desired unit for the output value (e.g., 'yard', 'kilometer', 'mile').

precision.description: The number of decimal places for the converted value. Defaults to 2.

unit.description: The unit of the converted value.

tools.name: convert_temperature
tools.description: Converts a temperature value between different scales (e.g., Celsius to Fahrenheit, Kelvin to Celsius).

value.description: The numeric temperature value to convert.

from_unit.description: The unit of the input temperature (e.g., 'celsius', 'fahrenheit', 'kelvin').

to_unit.description: The desired unit for the output temperature.

unit.description: The unit of the converted temperature.

tools.name: get_supported_units
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all supported units for a given conversion category (e.g., 'length', 'volume', 'mass'). This helps users understand what units can be used for conversions.

category.description: The category of units to retrieve (e.g., 'length', 'volume', 'mass', 'temperature', 'area').

include_aliases.description: If true, includes common aliases for units (e.g., 'm' for 'meter'). Defaults to false.

units.description: A comma-separated string of supported units for the category.

tools.name: convert_mass
tools.description: Converts a mass value from one unit to another (e.g., kilograms to pounds, ounces to grams).

value.description: The numeric value of mass to convert.

from_unit.description: The unit of the input mass (e.g., 'kilogram', 'pound', 'gram', 'ounce').

to_unit.description: The desired unit for the output mass.

round_to_nearest_half.description: If true, rounds the converted value to the nearest half unit. Defaults to false.

unit.description: The unit of the converted mass.

tools.name: convert_volume
tools.description: Converts a volume value from one unit to another (e.g., liters to gallons, milliliters to fluid ounces).

value.description: The numeric value of volume to convert.

from_unit.description: The unit of the input volume (e.g., 'liter', 'gallon', 'milliliter', 'fluid_ounce').

to_unit.description: The desired unit for the output volume.

decimal_places.description: The number of decimal places to round the result to. Maximum of 5. Defaults to 2.

unit.description: The unit of the converted volume.

tools.name: check_conversion_status
tools.description: Checks the status of the unit conversion service. This can be used to ensure the service is operational before attempting complex conversions.

service_name.description: The name of the specific conversion service component to check (e.g., 'length_converter', 'temperature_converter'). Optional, checks all if not provided.

verbose.description: If true, provides more detailed status information. Defaults to false.

overall_status.description: The overall status of the conversion service (e.g., 'operational', 'degraded', 'offline').

timestamp.description: The time the status was checked.

details.description: Detailed status information, if verbose is true.

tools.name: get_exchange_rate
tools.description: Retrieves the current exchange rate between two specified currencies. This tool can be used to find out how much one unit of a base currency is worth in a target currency.

base_currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the base currency (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR').

target_currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the target currency (e.g., 'GBP', 'JPY').

tools.name: convert_currency_amount
tools.description: Converts a specified amount from a source currency to a target currency using the latest exchange rates. This is useful for calculating how much money you would receive after a conversion.

amount.description: The amount to convert from the source currency.

source_currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency to convert from (e.g., 'CAD', 'MXN').

target_currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency to convert to (e.g., 'AUD', 'NZD').

allow_partial_conversion.description: If true, allows conversion of a partial amount if the full amount is not available or exceeds limits. Defaults to false.

tools.name: get_currency_historical_data
tools.description: Fetches historical exchange rate data for a given currency pair over a specified period. This helps analyze past trends and performance of currency rates.

base_currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the base currency.

target_currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the target currency.

start_date.description: The start date for the historical data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: The end date for the historical data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

interval.description: The aggregation interval for the historical data. Defaults to 'daily'.

tools.name: set_exchange_rate_alert
tools.description: Sets up an alert to notify the user when an exchange rate for a specified currency pair crosses a certain threshold. This is useful for users wanting to execute trades at a specific rate.

base_currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the base currency for the alert.

target_currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the target currency for the alert.

threshold_rate.description: The rate at which the alert should be triggered.

direction.description: The direction of the threshold: 'above' (rate goes above threshold) or 'below' (rate goes below threshold).

user_email.description: The email address to send the alert notification to.

tools.name: get_supported_currencies
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all currencies supported by the exchange service. This helps users know which currencies are available for exchange and other operations.

filter_by_region.description: Optional filter to list currencies by a specific geographical region (e.g., 'Europe', 'Asia').

include_inactive.description: If true, includes currencies that are currently inactive or deprecated. Defaults to false.

tools.name: execute_currency_swap
tools.description: Initiates an immediate swap of a specified amount from one currency to another in a user's account. This tool performs the actual transaction.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user initiating the swap.

source_currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency to swap from.

target_currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency to swap to.

source_amount.description: The amount to swap from the source currency.

confirm_transaction.description: A mandatory confirmation flag to proceed with the transaction. Must be true.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Sends an email to one or more recipients with a specified subject and body. Supports plain text or HTML content.

to_recipients.description: Comma-separated list of recipient email addresses.

cc_recipients.description: Comma-separated list of CC recipient email addresses (optional).

bcc_recipients.description: Comma-separated list of BCC recipient email addresses (optional).

subject.description: The subject line of the email.

body.description: The content of the email body.

is_html.description: Set to true if the body content is HTML, false for plain text. Defaults to false.

success.description: True if the email was sent successfully, false otherwise.

message.description: A message indicating the result of the operation.

email_id.description: Unique identifier for the sent email, if successful.

tools.name: mark_email_as_read_unread
tools.description: Changes the read status of a specific email. Can mark an email as read or unread.

email_id.description: The unique identifier of the email to update.

mark_as_read.description: Set to true to mark as read, false to mark as unread.

success.description: True if the email status was updated successfully, false otherwise.

message.description: A message indicating the result of the operation.

tools.name: delete_email
tools.description: Moves a specified email to the 'Deleted Items' folder.

email_id.description: The unique identifier of the email to delete.

force_permanent_delete.description: If true, permanently deletes the email skipping the 'Deleted Items' folder. Use with caution. Defaults to false.

success.description: True if the email was deleted successfully, false otherwise.

message.description: A message indicating the result of the operation.

tools.name: create_email_draft
tools.description: Creates a new email draft in the 'Drafts' folder. The draft can be later retrieved and sent.

to_recipients.description: Comma-separated list of recipient email addresses for the draft.

cc_recipients.description: Comma-separated list of CC recipient email addresses (optional).

subject.description: The subject line of the draft email.

body.description: The content of the email body for the draft.

is_html.description: Set to true if the body content is HTML, false for plain text. Defaults to false.

success.description: True if the draft was created successfully, false otherwise.

message.description: A message indicating the result of the operation.

draft_id.description: Unique identifier for the created email draft.

tools.name: get_email_details
tools.description: Retrieves the full details of a specific email, including sender, recipients, subject, body, and attachments.

email_id.description: The unique identifier of the email to retrieve.

include_attachments.description: If true, include details about attachments. Defaults to false.

success.description: True if the email details were retrieved successfully, false otherwise.

message.description: A message indicating the result of the operation.

to_recipients.description: Comma-separated list of To recipient email addresses.

cc_recipients.description: Comma-separated list of CC recipient email addresses.

restaurant_id.description: The unique identifier of the restaurant.

date.description: The desired date for the reservation (YYYY-MM-DD).

time.description: The desired time for the reservation (HH:MM).

number_of_guests.description: The number of people in the party.

customer_name.description: The name of the customer making the reservation.

customer_phone.description: The phone number of the customer for confirmation.

tools.name: cancel_reservation
tools.description: Cancels an existing table reservation using the reservation ID. This is useful when a user needs to change or cancel their dining plans.

reservation_id.description: The unique identifier of the reservation to be cancelled.

tools.name: get_restaurant_menu
tools.description: Retrieves the full menu for a specific restaurant, including dishes, descriptions, and prices. This helps users decide what to order before arriving or for takeout.

restaurant_id.description: The unique identifier of the restaurant.

tools.name: submit_restaurant_review
tools.description: Allows a user to submit a review for a restaurant, including a rating and optional text comments. This helps other users make informed dining decisions.

restaurant_id.description: The unique identifier of the restaurant being reviewed.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user submitting the review.

rating.description: The rating given to the restaurant (1-5 stars).

comment.description: Optional text comments about the dining experience.

tools.name: get_current_location
tools.description: Retrieves the current geographical location (latitude and longitude) of the user's device or a specified reference point. This tool is useful for determining 'where am I?' or for setting a starting point for navigation.

accuracy.description: Desired accuracy level for the location, e.g., 'high', 'medium', 'low'. Higher accuracy might take longer.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a location fix.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of when the location was recorded.

tools.name: search_points_of_interest
tools.description: Searches for points of interest (POIs) like restaurants, parks, or shops near a specified location or within a given area. Results can be filtered by category or keywords.

query.description: Keywords or category to search for, e.g., 'coffee shops', 'museums', 'gas station'.

latitude.description: Latitude of the center point for the search.

longitude.description: Longitude of the center point for the search.

radius_meters.description: Search radius in meters from the center point.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

open_now.description: If true, only return POIs that are currently open.

name.description: Name of the point of interest.

distance_meters.description: Distance from the search origin in meters.

rating.description: Average user rating for the POI.

tools.name: get_route_directions
tools.description: Calculates the optimal route and provides step-by-step directions between two or more locations. Supports various travel modes.

avoid_tolls.description: If true, the route will try to avoid toll roads.

total_distance_meters.description: Total distance of the route in meters.

total_duration_seconds.description: Estimated total travel time in seconds.

distance_meters.description: Distance for this step in meters.

duration_seconds.description: Estimated duration for this step in seconds.

tools.name: report_traffic_incident
tools.description: Allows users to report a traffic incident (e.g., accident, road closure, congestion) at a specific location, helping to update real-time traffic data.

description.description: Optional brief description of the incident.

status.description: Confirmation status of the report, e.g., 'success', 'pending_review'.

incident_id.description: Unique identifier for the reported incident.

tools.name: get_traffic_status
tools.description: Retrieves real-time traffic conditions for a specified area or along a given route. Provides information on congestion levels.

center_latitude.description: Latitude of the center point for traffic status inquiry.

center_longitude.description: Longitude of the center point for traffic status inquiry.

radius_meters.description: Radius in meters around the center point to get traffic status for.

road_name.description: Optional: Specific road name to get traffic status for.

area_congestion_level.description: Overall congestion level in the queried area, e.g., 'low', 'moderate', 'high'.

tools.name: request_ride
tools.description: Requests a ride from a specified pickup location to a destination. Allows specifying ride type and payment method.

pickup_latitude.description: The latitude of the pickup location.

pickup_longitude.description: The longitude of the pickup location.

payment_method_id.description: The ID of the payment method to use for the ride.

ride_id.description: The unique identifier for the requested ride.

estimated_fare.description: The estimated fare for the ride.

driver_eta_minutes.description: Estimated time of arrival for the driver in minutes.

tools.name: get_ride_status
tools.description: Retrieves the current status of an active or recently completed ride using its ride ID.

ride_id.description: The unique identifier of the ride to check status for.

status.description: The current status of the ride (e.g., 'pending', 'en_route_to_pickup', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'cancelled').

driver_name.description: The name of the assigned driver.

driver_phone_number.description: The phone number of the assigned driver.

vehicle_make.description: The make of the driver's vehicle.

vehicle_model.description: The model of the driver's vehicle.

vehicle_license_plate.description: The license plate number of the driver's vehicle.

tools.name: cancel_ride
tools.description: Cancels a pending or active ride. A reason for cancellation can be provided.

ride_id.description: The unique identifier of the ride to cancel.

cancellation_reason.description: Optional reason for canceling the ride (e.g., 'found another ride', 'driver taking too long').

success.description: True if the ride was successfully cancelled, false otherwise.

message.description: A message indicating the result of the cancellation attempt.

tools.name: get_available_ride_types
tools.description: Fetches a list of available ride types and their estimated prices for a given origin and destination.

origin_latitude.description: The latitude of the origin location.

origin_longitude.description: The longitude of the origin location.

destination_latitude.description: The latitude of the destination location.

destination_longitude.description: The longitude of the destination location.

type.description: The name of the ride type (e.g., 'Standard', 'Premium', 'XL').

estimated_fare.description: The estimated fare for this ride type.

estimated_pickup_time_minutes.description: Estimated time until a driver arrives for this ride type.

surge_multiplier.description: Current surge pricing multiplier for this ride type.

tools.name: update_ride_destination
tools.description: Updates the destination of an active ride. This may affect the fare.

ride_id.description: The unique identifier of the ride to update.

new_destination_latitude.description: The new latitude of the destination.

new_destination_longitude.description: The new longitude of the destination.

success.description: True if the destination was successfully updated, false otherwise.

new_estimated_fare.description: The new estimated fare after the destination change.

message.description: A message indicating the result of the update attempt.

tools.name: get_ride_history
tools.description: Retrieves a list of past rides for the authenticated user, optionally filtered by date range or ride status.

start_date.description: The start date for filtering ride history (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.description: The end date for filtering ride history (YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.description: Maximum number of rides to return.

offset.description: Number of rides to skip for pagination.

end_time.description: Timestamp when the ride ended (if completed).

final_fare.description: The final fare charged for the ride.

status.description: The final status of the ride.

total_rides.description: Total number of rides matching the criteria.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Creates a new task with a title, description, due date, and optional assignee.

description.description: A detailed description of the task.

due_date.description: The due date of the task in YYYY-MM-DD format.

assignee_id.description: The ID of the user assigned to the task.

priority.description: The priority level of the task (e.g., Low, Medium, High).

task_id.description: The unique ID of the newly created task.

status.description: The status of the task creation.

tools.name: get_tasks
tools.description: Retrieves a list of tasks, optionally filtered by assignee, status, or due date range.

assignee_id.description: Filter tasks by the ID of the assigned user.

status.description: Filter tasks by their current status (e.g., 'pending', 'in_progress', 'completed').

due_date_before.description: Filter tasks due before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

due_date_after.description: Filter tasks due after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

tools.name: update_task_status
tools.description: Updates the status of an existing task.

task_id.description: The unique ID of the task to update.

new_status.description: The new status for the task (e.g., 'pending', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'blocked').

task_id.description: The ID of the updated task.

status.description: Confirmation of the update status (e.g., 'success').

updated_status.description: The new status applied to the task.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Deletes a task by its unique ID.

task_id.description: The unique ID of the task to delete.

confirm_deletion.description: A boolean flag to confirm the deletion operation.

task_id.description: The ID of the task that was attempted to be deleted.

success.description: True if the task was successfully deleted, false otherwise.

message.description: A message indicating the outcome of the deletion attempt.

tools.name: assign_task_to_user
tools.description: Assigns an existing task to a specified user.

task_id.description: The unique ID of the task to assign.

user_id.description: The ID of the user to whom the task will be assigned.

send_notification.description: Whether to send a notification to the new assignee.

task_id.description: The ID of the task that was assigned.

assignee_id.description: The ID of the user the task was assigned to.

status.description: Confirmation of the assignment status (e.g., 'success').

tools.name: get_task_details
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for a single task by its ID.

task_id.description: The unique ID of the task to retrieve details for.

include_comments.description: Whether to include associated comments in the task details.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Creates a new note with specified content, title, and optional tags. The note will be saved with a unique identifier.

title.description: The title of the new note.

content.description: The main body content of the note.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags to categorize the note (e.g., 'work, meeting, urgent').

is_private.description: Whether the note should be private (true) or publicly viewable by collaborators (false). Defaults to false.

note_id.description: The unique identifier of the newly created note.

status.description: Status of the note creation (e.g., 'success', 'error').

tools.name: get_note_details
tools.description: Retrieves the full details of a specific note using its unique identifier. This includes its title, content, tags, and creation date.

note_id.description: The unique identifier of the note to retrieve.
The unique identifier of the note.

content.description: The main body content of the note.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags associated with the note.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the note was created.

last_modified_at.description: The timestamp when the note was last modified.

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Updates the title, content, or tags of an existing note identified by its unique ID. Only provided fields will be updated.

note_id.description: The unique identifier of the note to update.

title.description: The new title for the note.

content.description: The new content for the note.

tags.description: New comma-separated tags for the note (e.g., 'new_tag, updated').

is_private.description: Whether the note should be private (true) or publicly viewable by collaborators (false).

note_id.description: The unique identifier of the updated note.

status.description: Status of the note update (e.g., 'success', 'note_not_found').

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Deletes a note permanently using its unique identifier. This action cannot be undone.

note_id.description: The unique identifier of the note to delete.
The unique identifier of the note that was attempted to be deleted.

status.description: Status of the note deletion (e.g., 'success', 'note_not_found').

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Searches for notes based on keywords in their title or content, or by specific tags. Results can be filtered and paginated.

query.description: Keywords to search for in note titles or content.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags to filter notes by (e.g., 'work, urgent').

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return. Defaults to 10.

offset.description: Number of notes to skip before starting to return results (for pagination). Defaults to 0.

sort_by.description: Field to sort results by (e.g., 'created_at', 'last_modified_at', 'title'). Defaults to 'last_modified_at'.

sort_order.description: Order of sorting ('asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending). Defaults to 'desc'.

results.description: A JSON string representing an array of simplified note objects found, each with 'note_id', 'title', and 'tags'.

total_results.description: The total number of notes matching the search criteria.

tools.name: get_note_status
tools.description: Checks the current status of a note, such as whether it's active, archived, or trashed. This helps in managing note lifecycle.

note_id.description: The unique identifier of the note to check its status.
The unique identifier of the note.

status.description: The current lifecycle status of the note (e.g., 'active', 'archived', 'trashed', 'not_found').

tools.name: create_file
tools.description: Creates a new file with the specified content in the given path. If the path includes non-existent directories, they will be created.

file_path.description: The full path where the file should be created, including its name and extension (e.g., 'documents/report.txt').

content.description: The content to write into the new file.

overwrite.description: If true, overwrites the file if it already exists; otherwise, returns an error. Defaults to false.

success.description: True if the file was created successfully.

message.description: A descriptive message about the operation's outcome.

file_id.description: A unique identifier for the created file.

tools.name: read_file_content
tools.description: Reads and returns the content of a specified file. Useful for retrieving text-based file data.

file_path.description: The full path to the file whose content is to be read (e.g., 'config/settings.json').

encoding.description: The character encoding to use when reading the file (e.g., 'utf-8', 'latin-1'). Defaults to 'utf-8'.

success.description: True if the file content was read successfully.

message.description: A descriptive message about the operation's outcome.

content.description: The content of the file as a string.

tools.name: list_directory_contents
tools.description: Lists all files and subdirectories within a specified directory path. Provides details like size and last modified date.

directory_path.description: The path to the directory whose contents are to be listed (e.g., 'logs/', 'users/').

include_subdirectories.description: If true, recursively lists contents of subdirectories. Defaults to false.

filter_by_extension.description: Optional file extension to filter results (e.g., 'txt', 'pdf'). Do not include the dot.

min_size_kb.description: Minimum file size in kilobytes to include in the results.

max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return.

success.description: True if the directory contents were listed successfully.

message.description: A descriptive message about the operation's outcome.

contents.description: A JSON string representing an array of objects, each describing a file or directory (e.g., {'name': 'file.txt', 'type': 'file', 'size_bytes': 1234, 'last_modified': '2023-01-01T12:00:00Z'}).

tools.name: delete_file_or_directory
tools.description: Deletes a specified file or an empty directory. If deleting a directory, it must be empty unless 'recursive' is set to true.

path.description: The full path to the file or directory to be deleted (e.g., 'temp/old_data.csv', 'backup/').

is_directory.description: Set to true if the path refers to a directory. Defaults to false (assumes a file).

recursive.description: If true, recursively deletes directory and its contents. Only applicable when 'is_directory' is true. Defaults to false.

success.description: True if the file or directory was deleted successfully.

message.description: A descriptive message about the operation's outcome.

tools.name: move_file_or_directory
tools.description: Moves a file or directory from a source path to a destination path. Can also be used to rename an item by providing a new name in the destination path.

source_path.description: The current full path of the file or directory to be moved (e.g., 'drafts/report.docx').

destination_path.description: The new full path for the file or directory, including its new name if renaming (e.g., 'final/report_v2.docx').

overwrite_if_exists.description: If true, overwrites the destination if a file or directory already exists there. Defaults to false.

success.description: True if the file or directory was moved successfully.

message.description: A descriptive message about the operation's outcome.

tools.name: get_file_metadata
tools.description: Retrieves metadata for a specified file, such as size, creation date, last modified date, and permissions.

file_path.description: The full path to the file for which metadata is requested (e.g., 'images/profile.jpg').

success.description: True if file metadata was retrieved successfully.

message.description: A descriptive message about the operation's outcome.

metadata.description: A JSON string representing an object with file metadata (e.g., {'size_bytes': 10240, 'created_at': '2023-01-01T10:00:00Z', 'last_modified_at': '2023-01-05T15:30:00Z', 'permissions': 'rw-r--r--'}).

tools.name: create_new_spreadsheet
tools.description: Creates a brand new, empty spreadsheet with a specified name and optionally a parent folder ID.

spreadsheet_name.description: The desired name for the new spreadsheet.

parent_folder_id.description: Optional ID of the parent folder where the spreadsheet should be created.

spreadsheet_id.description: The unique identifier of the newly created spreadsheet.

spreadsheet_url.description: The URL to access the new spreadsheet.

tools.name: read_spreadsheet_data
tools.description: Reads a range of data from a specified sheet within a spreadsheet. Useful for retrieving cell values.

spreadsheet_id.description: The unique identifier of the spreadsheet.

sheet_name.description: The name of the sheet within the spreadsheet (e.g., 'Sheet1').

major_dimension.description: The dimension that data is grouped by in the results: 'ROWS' or 'COLUMNS'. Defaults to 'ROWS'.

values.description: A JSON string representation of the 2D array of values from the specified range.

range.description: The actual range covered by the response.

tools.name: update_spreadsheet_cell
tools.description: Updates the value of a single cell or a small range of cells in a spreadsheet.

spreadsheet_id.description: The unique identifier of the spreadsheet.

sheet_name.description: The name of the sheet within the spreadsheet.

cell_address.description: The address of the cell to update (e.g., 'A1', 'B5').

new_value.description: The new value to set for the specified cell.

value_input_option.description: How the input data should be interpreted: 'RAW' (as-is) or 'USER_ENTERED' (parsed as if entered in UI). Defaults to 'RAW'.

updated_range.description: The range of cells that were updated.

updated_cells.description: The number of cells that were updated.

tools.name: add_new_sheet
tools.description: Adds a new sheet (tab) to an existing spreadsheet with a specified title.

spreadsheet_id.description: The unique identifier of the spreadsheet to add the sheet to.

sheet_title.description: The title for the new sheet.

index.description: The zero-based index where the new sheet should be inserted. If omitted, the sheet is added at the end.

sheet_id.description: The unique ID of the newly created sheet.

sheet_title.description: The title of the newly created sheet.

tools.name: delete_spreadsheet
tools.description: Deletes an entire spreadsheet by its ID. This action is irreversible.

spreadsheet_id.description: The unique identifier of the spreadsheet to be deleted.

confirm_deletion.description: Must be set to 'true' to confirm the deletion. This is a safety measure.

success.description: Indicates whether the spreadsheet was successfully deleted.

message.description: A confirmation message or error details.

tools.name: find_rows_matching_criteria
tools.description: Searches for rows in a specified sheet where a particular column's value matches a given search term. Returns the matching rows.

spreadsheet_id.description: The unique identifier of the spreadsheet.

sheet_name.description: The name of the sheet to search within.

search_column_name.description: The header name of the column to search in (e.g., 'Product ID', 'Customer Name').

search_value.description: The value to search for within the specified column.

case_sensitive.description: Whether the search should be case-sensitive. Defaults to false.

header_row_index.description: The 0-based index of the row containing headers. Defaults to 0 (first row).

matching_rows.description: A JSON string representing an array of objects, where each object is a matching row with column headers as keys.

row_count.description: The number of rows found that match the criteria.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Searches for products based on a query, category, and optional filters like price range or brand. This tool helps users find specific items they want to buy.

query.description: The search term for the product (e.g., 'wireless headphones', 'men's running shoes').

category.description: The category to narrow down the search (e.g., 'Electronics', 'Apparel', 'Home Goods').

min_price.description: The minimum price for the product.

max_price.description: The maximum price for the product.

brand.description: The brand of the product to filter by.

page_number.description: The page number for pagination of search results, starting from 1.

currency.description: Currency of the price (e.g., USD, EUR).

availability.description: True if the product is in stock, false otherwise.

rating.description: Average customer rating for the product.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Adds a specified quantity of a product to the user's shopping cart. This action is crucial for users to collect items before checkout.

product_id.description: The unique identifier of the product to add to the cart.

quantity.description: The number of units of the product to add.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user performing the action.

color.description: The color variant of the product, if applicable.

size.description: The size variant of the product, if applicable.

cart_item_id.description: Unique identifier for the item added to the cart.

product_id.description: The ID of the product added.

quantity_added.description: The actual quantity of the product added to the cart.

success.description: True if the item was successfully added, false otherwise.

tools.name: get_cart_contents
tools.description: Retrieves the current contents of a user's shopping cart, including product details and quantities. This allows users to review their selections.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose cart contents are to be retrieved.

cart_id.description: Unique identifier for the shopping cart.

total_items.description: Total number of distinct items in the cart.

total_price.description: The total price of all items in the cart.

currency.description: Currency of the total price (e.g., USD, EUR).

tools.description: Finalizes the purchase process by creating an order from the current items in the user's cart. This initiates the payment and shipping process.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user placing the order.

promo_code.description: An optional promotional code to apply to the order.

order_total.description: The final total price of the order.

status.description: Current status of the order (e.g., 'Pending', 'Processing').

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Checks the current status of a previously placed order using its unique ID. Users can track the progress of their purchases.

order_id.description: The unique identifier of the order to check.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user who placed the order.

status.description: Current status of the order (e.g., 'Processing', 'Shipped', 'Delivered').

tracking_number.description: The tracking number for the shipment, if available.

estimated_delivery_date.description: Estimated date of delivery in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.description: Removes a specific quantity of a product or an entire product line from the user's shopping cart. This allows users to modify their selections before checkout.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose cart is being modified.

product_id.description: The unique identifier of the product to remove from the cart.

quantity.description: The number of units of the product to remove. If not provided, all units of the product will be removed.

product_id.description: The ID of the product that was removed or had its quantity reduced.

quantity_removed.description: The actual quantity of the product removed from the cart.

remaining_quantity.description: The quantity of the product remaining in the cart after the operation.

tools.description: Retrieves the current status and estimated delivery time for a specific order using its unique order ID.

order_id.description: The unique identifier for the order.

tools.description: Fetches a list of all orders associated with a given customer ID, optionally filtering by status or date range.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier for the customer.

status_filter.description: Optional filter to retrieve orders with a specific status.

start_date.description: Optional start date for filtering orders (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.description: Optional end date for filtering orders (YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to return.

tools.description: Allows updating the delivery address for an order if it has not yet been shipped. Requires the order ID and the new address details.

order_id.description: The unique identifier for the order.

new_street_address.description: The new street address for delivery.

new_zip_code.description: The new zip code for delivery.

tools.description: Cancels an existing order if it is still in a 'Processing' or 'Pending' status. A reason for cancellation is required.

order_id.description: The unique identifier for the order to be cancelled.

cancellation_reason.description: The reason for cancelling the order.

tools.description: Retrieves the historical price data for a given product over a specified period.

end_date.description: The end date for the price history in YYYY-MM-DD format.

retailer_id.description: Optional: Filter history for a specific retailer.
